# scenario

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
scenario description
```

Given events, a trigger, and what follows: an example the process owner reads.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-scenario-description"></a>`description` | `String.t` | yes |  | The case, in the owner's words. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-scenario-target"></a>`target` | `atom` |  |  | The unit or reaction the case is about, when the trigger does not say which. |
| <a id="contract-scenario-actor"></a>`actor` | `atom` |  |  | The actor who issues the command. |
| <a id="contract-scenario-rejected"></a>`rejected` | `atom` |  |  | The invariant the command is refused on. |
| <a id="contract-scenario-illustrates"></a>`illustrates` | `atom \| list(atom)` |  | `[]` | The rules this case shows: a constraint of the policy, process manager or query, or an invariant of the process manager. |
| <a id="contract-scenario-ended"></a>`ended` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Whether the process manager ends. |
